title: Kinetically controlled self-assembly of Zn-porphyrin nanostructures via surfactant-assisted micelle formation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48757-48761
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09001F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yun Mi Park, Ka Young Kim, Juyeong Kim, Ji Ha Lee, Jong Hwa Jung, Sung Ho Jung
Zn-TPyP nanotubes were formed via surfactant-assisted micelle encapsulation, enabling kinetically controlled self-assembly. The resulting J-aggregates showed enhanced optical and photocatalytic properties.
